summary.tagline: At around 6.8 square kilometres, the Achensee is the largest lake in Tirol, lying at 929 metres above sea leve

days.title: Culture and Recreation in Achenkirch
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Achenkirch
stops.detail: Farming traditions and the Sixenhof local heritage museum shape Achenkirch as much as water sports and golf.

stops.name: Achensee Nord beach
stops.detail: On the northern shore is the Achensee Nord beach at Achenkirch; at Maurach, the Atoll Achensee has a lake pool with a lawn for sunbathing.

days.title: Leisure and Heights in Maurach
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Rofan cable car
stops.detail: The village sits at the southern end of the lake, between the Atoll Achensee leisure centre on the shore and the valley station of the Rofan cable car.

stops.name: Wusel lake trail
stops.detail: The Wusel lake trail runs for 3.8 kilometres along the eastern shore of the Achensee.

days.title: Lakeside Activity in Pertisau
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Pertisau
stops.detail: On the western shore of the lake, Pertisau is a starting point for walks and a landing stage for the Achensee boat services.

stops.name: Vitalberg
stops.detail: At the Vitalberg in Pertisau, you can follow the story of the shale-oil distillers and see how the oil is extracted from the rock.

stops.name: Strandbad Pertisau
stops.detail: On the western shore, the Strandbad Pertisau has a large lawn right by the water.

stops.name: Seebergspitze
stops.detail: Walking routes range from easy circuits along the shore to alpine ascents of the Seebergspitze.
